semiconductor_relevance: High — Accuera Ltd provides high-precision components and subassemblies crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Accuera Ltd specializes in manufacturing high-precision components and subassemblies for the semiconductor industry, including custom vacuum chucks, adaptors, and end effectors. Their products are designed to meet stringent tolerances and are used in various semiconductor manufacturing processes, supporting R&D and development teams with prototypes and small-batch production.
capabilities: Custom vacuum chucks up to Ø450 mm
